title: [실습] Dokcer Compose로 백엔드(Next.js) 실행
markdown:
## Dokcer Compose로 백엔드(Next.js) 실행 ---
1. Nest.js 프로젝트 생성 ```bash # Nest CLI 설치 $ npm i -g @nestjs/cli # nest new {프로젝트명} $ nest new my-server ```
2. Dockerfile, .dockerignore, compose 파일 작성 Dockerfile ```bash FROM node WORKDIR /app COPY . . RUN npm install RUN npm run build EXPOSE 3000 ENTRYPOINT [ "node", "dist/main.js" ] ``` .dockerignore ```bash node_modules ``` compose 파일 작성
참고) Docker CLI ```bash docker build -t my-server . docker run -d -p 3000:3000 my-server ```
```bash services: my-server: build: . # 같은 경로에 있는 Dockerfile을 사용하여 image build ports: - 3000:3000 ```
3. compose 파일 실행 ```bash docker compose up -d --build ```
4. compose 실행 현황 보기 ```bash docker compose ps docker ps ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8163-adff-df595625441b/05c8dc12b95adbb1.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8163-adff-df595625441b/55d26de1408d04fa.webp)
5. localhost:3000 호출 ```bash curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000" ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8163-adff-df595625441b/dc2caca1fdda645a.webp)
6. compose 실행 컨테이너 삭제 ```bash docker compose down ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8163-adff-df595625441b/8506b1f48242d528.webp)
